title: College Bus Route Planner
oneLiner: A console TSP solver that plans the optimal bus route across college stops.
claim: Solves the same route three ways - brute force, nearest neighbour and branch and bound - and lets you compare them.

metrics: Three algorithms side by side: brute-force exact, greedy nearest-neighbour heuristic, and branch and bound
Stops and the distance matrix can be edited at runtime
Configurations save to and load from a file
proof.architecture: A distance matrix and a stop list drive the solver. Exact and heuristic methods are written behind the same interface so a route can be recomputed under each and compared directly, with the matrix persisted so a scenario survives a restart.
